dct_description_sm: Research conducted by the Labrador Highlands Research Group on the climate and ecology of the Mealy Mountains has been ongoing since 2001. One of the main goals of this research is to come away with a multidisciplinary understanding of tree line dynamics. This knowledge will be combined as inputs for a climate-vegetation model being produced at Memorial University. The purpose of this specific project is to examine the role that seed productivity and pre-dispersal seed limitation may play in these dynamics. The role of predispersal seed loss to invertebrate predators and disease will also be evaluated through the inspection of sampled seed cones. This study will therefore provide data on the viable seed contribution/unit area of a given species to the surrounding environment.
dct_title_s: Seed cone productivity in various habitat types within tree line dynamics in the Mealy Mountains, Labrador
